name: com.reactivesolutions.attributesystem
description: A reactive attribute management system for Unity. Designed for RPGs and shooters, it supports complex modifier chains and data-driven StatBlocks via JSON. Built on UniRx for loose coupling and event-driven state updates. Currently has little support for multiple AttributeSystems inside a same scene (it is possible, but they do not interact out of the box)

samples.description: A small RPG built from JSON data: character templates, Health and Mana pools, gear that adds to its owner, inventory weight, a party aura and a frenzied goblin. Add the RPG Starter Demo component to an empty GameObject and press Play.
